summary: Semantic quote attributed to a person.
whenToUse: Showing a testimonial or quote with author and role.
whenNotToUse: For a biography or a full profile, use ProfileCard.
accessibility: The quote uses blockquote and the attribution is the figure caption.
The avatar is decorative because the name is visible.
responsive: Text wraps without requiring a minimum width.
customization: Text, surfaces, and spacing derive from --dc-* tokens.
commonMistakes: Do not use the quote for content that is not actually attributed.
limits: Does not verify or format the cited source.
